data.one_liner: An in-app debug kits platform for Flutter apps produced by the ByteDance Flutter Infra team.
data.what_it_does: Provides an in-app debugging platform with 13 built-in plugin kits (such as UI inspectors, performance monitors, device info, console, and Dio network inspection). Allows developers to create custom plugin kits and integrate them into UME.
use_when: You need in-app debugging tools and visual inspectors for your Flutter application.
You want to inspect UI layouts, performance, memory, device information, and network requests directly inside the running app.
avoid_when: You are running your app in release mode (where VM service and some debugging features are unavailable or discouraged).
You do not want any third-party debug overlays included in your application builds.
strengths: Comprehensive built-in plugins for UI, performance, device info, console output, and network logging.
Extensible architecture allowing the creation of custom debug plugin kits.
weaknesses: Some functions rely on VM Service and require specific run parameters like --no-dds.
Not recommended for use in release or profile modes due to potential risks and lack of VM Service.
data.setup_notes: Add dependencies to pubspec.yaml, initialize PluginManager and wrap your app with UMEWidget in debug mode.
